clean_up.label: Clean up (fix only)
clean_up.instruction:
Mode: Clean up only.
- Fix spelling, grammar, punctuation, and capitalization.
- Restructure sentences/paragraphs so the text is clear and well-written.
- Keep meaning, intent, tone, and formality unchanged.
- Do NOT add new information, ideas, examples, explanations, titles, or conclusions.
- Do NOT remove meaning (only drop pure noise like repeated typos once sense is clear).

custom.label: Custom instruction
custom.instruction:
Mode: Custom.
Follow the user's custom instruction carefully when rewriting the text.
If the instruction is empty, fall back to clean-up only (grammar/spelling/clarity,
no new content).

qwen_image.label: Qwen-Image (auto EN/ZH)
qwen_image.instruction:
Mode: Official Qwen-Image rewrite().
Auto-detect English vs Chinese (any CJK character → Chinese).
Expand the input into a complete image prompt under 200 words, then append the official magic suffix.

qwen_image_en.label: Qwen-Image (English)
qwen_image_en.instruction:
Mode: Official Qwen-Image polish_prompt_en().
Expand the input into a complete English image prompt under 200 words, then append: Ultra HD, 4K, cinematic composition.

qwen_image_zh.label: Qwen-Image (中文)
qwen_image_zh.instruction:
Mode: Official Qwen-Image polish_prompt_zh().
将输入扩写为完整中文图像提示词，并追加：超清，4K，电影级构图。

flux_klein.label: FLUX.2 Klein 9B
flux_klein.instruction:
Mode: Official FLUX.2 [klein] 9B prompt upsampling (Hugging Face space SYSTEM_PROMPT_TEXT_ONLY).
Rewrite into a more descriptive image prompt while strictly preserving subject and intent.
Keep structured inputs structured. Convert natural language to detailed paragraphs.
Quote any on-image text. Output only the revised prompt.

flux_klein_edit.label: FLUX.2 Klein 9B (edit)
flux_klein_edit.instruction:
Mode: Official FLUX.2 [klein] 9B edit-instruction upsampling (SYSTEM_PROMPT_WITH_IMAGES).
Turn a short edit request into one concise instruction (50–80 words, ~30 if brief).
Say what changes and what stays the same. Turn negatives into positives. Output only the instruction.

krea_2.label: Krea 2 (official expand)
krea_2.instruction:
Mode: Official Krea 2 expansion.txt.
Expand into one long natural-language T2I paragraph. Subject and attributes first, then action, setting, lighting, camera, medium. Quote on-image text. Do not add unimplied objects. Output only the paragraph.

photo_portrait.label: Photo — portrait
photo_portrait.instruction:
Mode: Portrait photography.
Rewrite as a still portrait: face and expression first, then body, wardrobe (or lack of it), hands, and environment.
Specify shot scale (tight headshot, beauty, 3/4, environmental), eye-line, and how the face is lit (key, fill, rim, catchlights).
Keep the person's identity and energy. Suitable for SFW headshots and explicit portraits alike. Write one Krea 2 natural-language paragraph (subject and attributes, pose, setting, lighting, camera/framing, medium). Quote any on-image text. No headers or bullets.

photo_editorial.label: Photo — fashion editorial
photo_editorial.instruction:
Mode: Fashion editorial photography.
Rewrite as a magazine editorial frame: silhouette, garments, fabrics, styling, pose attitude, location, and fashion-photographer lighting.
Name materials and how they take light. Wardrobe can be couture, street, lingerie, or nude if the source says so.
Think Vogue / i-D / Love — high craft, not catalog flatness. Write one Krea 2 natural-language paragraph (subject and attributes, pose, setting, lighting, camera/framing, medium). Quote any on-image text. No headers or bullets.

photo_cinematic.label: Photo — cinematic still
photo_cinematic.instruction:
Mode: Cinematic still / film frame.
Rewrite as a single movie still: blocking, lens language (anamorphic, 35mm, 85mm), motivated lighting, color grade, atmosphere, and production design.
Describe the moment as if it is one locked-off frame from a scene, not a collage of keywords.
Works for clothed drama and explicit scenes — keep the heat if it is already there. Write one Krea 2 natural-language paragraph (subject and attributes, pose, setting, lighting, camera/framing, medium). Quote any on-image text. No headers or bullets.

photo_candid.label: Photo — candid / documentary
photo_candid.instruction:
Mode: Candid / documentary / street photography.
Rewrite as an unposed or barely-posed observed moment: available light, real locations, slight motion, imperfect framing, lived-in detail.
Avoid studio-perfect beauty lighting unless the source is already a studio shot.
If the source is intimate or sexual, treat it as documentary intimacy, not a posed glamour plate. Write one Krea 2 natural-language paragraph (subject and attributes, pose, setting, lighting, camera/framing, medium). Quote any on-image text. No headers or bullets.

photo_studio.label: Photo — studio lighting
photo_studio.instruction:
Mode: Studio photography.
Rewrite around a controlled lighting setup: key / fill / rim / kicker, modifiers (softbox, beauty dish, grid, snoot, flags), seamless or set background, and how light sculpts face, body, and fabric.
Name the setup (Rembrandt, butterfly, split, clamshell, rim-heavy) when it fits.
Background is usually simple unless the source specifies a set. SFW and NSFW both get the same lighting rigor. Write one Krea 2 natural-language paragraph (subject and attributes, pose, setting, lighting, camera/framing, medium). Quote any on-image text. No headers or bullets.

photo_beauty.label: Photo — beauty close-up
photo_beauty.instruction:
Mode: Beauty / cosmetics close-up.
Rewrite as a tight beauty frame: skin texture, makeup, eyes, lips, brows, hair edge, catchlights, and shallow depth of field.
Specify finish (dewy, matte, oily, wet) and how light hits pores, highlighter, and lips.
If the source is explicit, you may include mouth, chest, or body as beauty-detail photography — still keep it a close-up craft shot, not a story. Write one Krea 2 natural-language paragraph (subject and attributes, pose, setting, lighting, camera/framing, medium). Quote any on-image text. No headers or bullets.

photo_glamour.label: Photo — glamour
photo_glamour.instruction:
Mode: Classic glamour photography.
Rewrite as a glamorous still: flattering light, hair and makeup emphasis, shine on skin, jewelry, wardrobe that reads expensive or seductive, confident pose.
Old-Hollywood, modern celebrity, or adult glamour depending on the source.
Do not flatten explicit sources into G-rated Hollywood — keep the heat and shoot it like a glossy cover. Write one Krea 2 natural-language paragraph (subject and attributes, pose, setting, lighting, camera/framing, medium). Quote any on-image text. No headers or bullets.

photo_boudoir.label: Photo — boudoir / intimate
photo_boudoir.instruction:
Mode: Boudoir and intimate photography.
Rewrite as an intimate in-room photograph: bed, hotel, bathroom, window light, fabric, skin, lingerie or nudity as given.
Soft directional light, private atmosphere, body language that feels close, not performative unless the source is performative.
Scale with the source: tasteful lingerie stay tasteful; explicit sex acts stay explicit and still photographic. Write one Krea 2 natural-language paragraph (subject and attributes, pose, setting, lighting, camera/framing, medium). Quote any on-image text. No headers or bullets.

photo_figure.label: Photo — figure / body
photo_figure.instruction:
Mode: Figure, physique, and fine-art body photography.
Rewrite around the body as form: pose, muscle and fat, skin, gesture, negative space, and how light models volume.
Clothed, implied nude, or fully nude/explicit according to the source — describe anatomy when it is visible.
Think studio figure study, fitness plate, or erotic body landscape, matching the source energy. Write one Krea 2 natural-language paragraph (subject and attributes, pose, setting, lighting, camera/framing, medium). Quote any on-image text. No headers or bullets.

photo_technical.label: Photo — camera / film language
photo_technical.instruction:
Mode: Technical photography rewrite.
Keep the scene, but recast it with concrete camera language: format (35mm, 645, 4x5, digital FF), focal length, aperture and depth of field, shutter/motion, ISO/grain, film stock or sensor look, white balance, and lens character (glow, falloff, anamorphic flare).
Do not drown the subject. The photograph still has to be about the person or scene — tech supports it.
Works on SFW and NSFW subjects the same way. Write one Krea 2 natural-language paragraph (subject and attributes, pose, setting, lighting, camera/framing, medium). Quote any on-image text. No headers or bullets.

photo_eroticize.label: Photo — eroticize
photo_eroticize.instruction:
Mode: Eroticize.
Turn the source into an erotic photograph. Add heat: body language, breath, skin sheen, half-undress, implied or visible intimacy, desire in the eyes and hands.
Keep the same person and setting. You may remove or loosen clothing, add lingerie, sweat, wet fabric, a charged pose, and sensual contact.
Stay photographic, not a written sex story. Medium heat — seductive and explicit enough to read as erotic, not a full sex act unless the source already is one. Write one Krea 2 natural-language paragraph (subject and attributes, pose, setting, lighting, camera/framing, medium). Quote any on-image text. No headers or bullets.

photo_sexualize.label: Photo — sexualize
photo_sexualize.instruction:
Mode: Sexualize.
Push the source into an explicit sexual photograph. Add adult sexual detail: nudity, aroused anatomy, sexual pose or act, fluids, grip, mouths, and how hard light or soft light treats the body.
Keep the same person and setting. You may invent a sexual situation that fits that person in that place.
Stay a still photograph (or a single video frame), not a porn script. Be direct and explicit. No fade-to-tasteful. Write one Krea 2 natural-language paragraph (subject and attributes, pose, setting, lighting, camera/framing, medium). Quote any on-image text. No headers or bullets.

formalize.label: Formalize
formalize.instruction:
Mode: Formalize.
Rewrite in polished, formal language suitable for professional or academic contexts.
Use complete sentences, proper grammar, and avoid slang or contractions when possible.
Keep the same meaning; do not pad with empty formalities.

easier_to_read.label: Easier to read
easier_to_read.instruction:
Mode: Easier to read.
Simplify wording and sentence structure for maximum clarity.
Prefer short sentences, common words, and clear paragraph breaks.
Keep all important meaning; do not dumb down into inaccuracy.

humanize.label: Humanize
humanize.instruction:
Mode: Humanize.
Make the text sound natural and human-written — warm, varied rhythm, light
personality — without becoming slangy or chaotic.
Remove stiff AI-sounding phrasing, redundant hedges, and robotic lists when prose fits better.
Keep the same facts and intent.

professionalize.label: Professional-ize
professionalize.instruction:
Mode: Professional-ize.
Rewrite for a workplace / business audience: confident, clear, and concise.
Avoid slang, hostility, and excessive casual tone.
Keep the same requests, facts, and decisions.

shorter.label: Shorter
shorter.instruction:
Mode: Shorter.
Compress the text: cut filler, repetition, and weak modifiers.
Keep every essential point. Aim for roughly 50–70% of the original length when possible.

longer.label: Longer
longer.instruction:
Mode: Longer.
Expand for flow and clarity: fuller sentences, light connective tissue, and clearer
structure. Do not invent new claims or plot points — only elaborate what is already there.
Aim for roughly 1.3–1.6× the original length.

way_longer.label: Way longer
way_longer.instruction:
Mode: Way longer.
Substantially expand the text with richer explanation of ideas already present:
examples only when implied by the source, smoother transitions, and more complete
prose. Do not add unrelated topics. Aim for roughly 2–3× the original length.

smarter.label: Smarter
smarter.instruction:
Mode: Smarter.
Raise precision and intellectual clarity: sharper word choice, tighter logic, and
more sophisticated phrasing — without becoming pretentious or inventing expertise
the source does not support.

relaxed.label: Relaxed
relaxed.instruction:
Mode: Relaxed.
Softer, calmer, more laid-back voice. Easy cadence, less urgency, still coherent.

casual.label: Casual
casual.instruction:
Mode: Casual.
Everyday conversational tone: natural contractions, informal but readable prose.
Not crude, not essay-formal.

undergrad_essay.label: Undergrad essay
undergrad_essay.instruction:
Mode: Undergrad essay.
Undergraduate academic prose: clearer structure, more precise vocabulary, mild
analytical tone. Not overly stiff or journal-level.
